questions.question: A can finish 3/5th of a task in 6 days and B can finish 2/3th of the same task in 12 days. A and B worked together for 5 days. C alone completed the remaining task in 8 days. B and C, working together, will complete the same task in:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A can finish frac 3 5 of a task = 6 days 

B can finish frac 2 3 of the same task = 12 days

A and B worked together = 5 days

C alone completed the remaining task = 8 days

**Concept Used:**

If a man can do a work in t days then in 1 day he will do 1/t part of the work

**Calculation:**

A alone can finish task = 6 × (5/3)

⇒ 10 days

B alone can finish task = 12 × (3/2)

⇒18 days

⇒ A and B worked for 5 days = (5/10) + (5/18)

⇒ (45 + 25) /90 = 70/90

⇒ 7/9

⇒ Remaining work = 1 - (7/9)

⇒ 20/90 = 2/9

2/9th of work completed by C = 8 days

C alone can finish task = 8 × (9/2) = 36 days

⇒ B + C working together can do in 1 day = 1/18 + 1/36

⇒ (2 + 1)/36 = 3/36 = 1/12

In one day B and C together can complete = 1/12 of the task

B and C together can complete a task = 12 day

**∴ The number of days taken to complete a task B and C together is 12**

questions.question: If x + y + z = 5, x² + y² + z² = 21 and y² = zx, then the value of y is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

x + y + z = 5

x² + y² + z² = 21

y² = zx

**Formula used:**

(x + y + z)² = x2 + y2 + z² + 2(xy + yz + xz)

**Calculations:**

(x + y + z)² = 5²

⇒ x2 + y2 + z2 + 2(xy + yz + xz) = 25

⇒ 21 + 2(xy + yz + xz) = 25

⇒ 2(xy + yz + xz) = 25 - 21

⇒ xy + yz + xz = 4/2

⇒ xy + yz + xz = 2

⇒ xy + yz+ y² = 2

⇒ y(x + y + z) = 2

⇒ y(5) = 2

⇒ y = 2/5

**∴ The required value of y = 2/5**

questions.question: Two trains are running in opposite directions on parallel tracks at the speeds of 42 km/h and 57 km/h, respectively. They take 18 seconds to cross each other. If the length of one train is 295 m, then the length (in m) of the other train is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Speed of first train = 42 km/hr

Speed of second train = 57 km/hr

Total time taken to cross each other = 18 seconds

Length of on train = 295m

**Concept used:**

Two trains are running in opposite directions on parallel tracks then the relative speed is sum of the speeds

**Formula used:**

Relative speed = Speed of first train + speed of second train 

Distance = speed × time

a km/hr = 5/18 m/sec

**Calculations:**

Relative speed = 42 + 57

⇒ 99 km/hr

99 km/hr = 99 × 5/18

⇒ 55/2 m/sec

Distance covered = 295 + x

⇒ 295 + x = 55/2 × 18

⇒ 295 + x = 55 × 9

⇒ x = 495 - 295 

⇒ x = 200

**∴ The length of second train is 200 m**

⇒ x + y = 63 - 53

x = y condition doesn't satify 

x = 9

questions.question: One-sixth of one-half of three-eighth of a number is 20. What will be 40% of that number?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

One-sixth of one-half of three-eighth of a number = 20

**Calculation:**

Let the number be 'x'

(1/6)(1/2)(3/8)x = 20

⇒ x = 20 × 8 × 2 × 6/3 

⇒ x = 640

40% of that number = 40% of 640

⇒ 640 × 40/100 = 256

**∴ The 40% of that number is 256**

The average weight of students in a class was 60.5 kg. When 8 students, whose average weight was 65 kg, joined the class, then the average weight of all the students increased by 0.9 kg. The total number of students now in the class is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average weight of students in class = 60.5 kg

When 8 students joined in class average weight = 65

The average weight of all students is increased = 0.9

**Concept Used:**

Sum = Average × Number of observation

**Calculations:**

Let the number of students initially be 'x'

Total weight of students initially = 60.5 × x

Total weight of total students = 65 × 8

⇒ 520

Total number of students after 8 students joined in class = x + 8

Increased average = 60.5 + 0.9

⇒ 61.4

Total weight of students = 520 + 60.5x

⇒ 61.4(x + 8) = 520 + 60.5x

⇒ 61.4x + 491.2 = 520 + 60.5x

⇒ 0.9x = 520 - 491.2

⇒ x = 28.8/0.9

⇒ x = 32

Total number of students = x + 8

⇒ 32 + 8 = 40

**∴ The number of students in class is 40**

Two successive discounts = 20% and 10% respectively

Selling price = Marked price × (100 - x)/100 × (100 - y)/100

⇒ 600(1 - 20/100) = 600(100 - 20)/100

⇒ 600 × 80/100 = 480

After allowing Second discount 10% = 480 - 480 × (10/100)

⇒ 480(1 - 10/100) = 480(100 - 10)/100

⇒ 480 × 90/100 = 432
